- **Status:** Proposed | Accepted | Accepted (implementer, pending learner review) | Superseded by ADR-0MM

- **Supersedes:** ADR-0XX (if any)
- **Context:** <the situation and the forces at play: what problem, what constraints, what facts (with sources)?
